description: Freetown City Council publishes a set of simple online maps of public facilities in Sierra Leone's capital, one for each theme. The health map names about 67 places, including the city's main hospitals such as Connaught, Princess Christian Maternity and Ola During Children's hospitals, community health centres and other public health units. Other maps show public markets, waste management and storage sites, bus stations and the ferry terminal, schools and colleges, environmental control points, community and religious centres and sports grounds. Each map is a Google My Maps layer embedded on a council page, and the points are available to download free as KML through the standard Google My Maps export. Caveats: the layers are small and hand-drawn, carry names and locations but no capacities or attributes, show no edit date, and have no stated licence; the water and sanitation page had no map when read. Coverage is the city of Freetown. Simulation uses: exposure of hospitals, markets and waste sites to Freetown's floods and landslides, and access planning for emergency response. Related records: Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) gives a national facility layer to cross-check against the council's health map.
